title: 1 Million Now or 1 Cent Doubled for 30 Days? 💶 #shorts
description:
1 million euros now, or 1 cent that doubles every day for 30 days? Comment 1 or 2.

On day 20 the cent is only worth 5,242.88 €. On day 30 it's 5,368,709.12 €, and half of it arrives on the last day. Real money doesn't double daily, but compound growth follows the same curve over years: at an assumed ~6 % a year (Finanztip planning return, monthly compounding, before tax and costs), 1,000 € invested once at 16 could be about 17,700 € at 64. Returns are not guaranteed; values go up and down, and the past is no promise. Not financial advice.

Sources: Finanztip (6 % planning return for stock ETFs, Feb 2025); maths in Python
